name: Flohmarkt Innenstadt

rhythm.de: An mehreren Sonntagen zwischen April und Oktober
rhythm.en: On several Sundays between April and October

facts: the city itself runs the market, between April and October
stalls stand on Rathausplatz, Fleethörn, Willestraße, Asmus-Bremer-Platz, Holstenstraße, Europaplatz and Holstenplatz
no commercial traders, and no new goods except handicraft and hobby work
food, live animals, plants, weapons and imitation weapons may not be sold
no booking and no reservation is possible
the pitch fee is 5 EUR per running metre, paid in cash on the day
chalk marks for a pitch are tolerated from 22:00 the night before and lapse at 05:00
sellers take their rubbish and unsold things home
two of the city's markets each year are special markets for children's things and toys
notes: The city's 2026 list ends with 27 September in the city centre and 4 October at the Hörn, so only 27 September falls in this window and the season starts again in April. The 4 October market at Querkai / Kaistraße 101 is a separate market on the same list, not this one. No entry fee is mentioned because it is a public street market with nothing to pay to walk in — recorded as 0. The page still carries a stale line, "Die Termine für 2025 folgen", beside the 2026 dates; the full 2026 list is the linked flohmarkttermine.pdf on the same page. Coordinates from Nominatim for Rathausplatz, one end of the market.

description.de: An mehreren Sonntagen zwischen April und Oktober zieht sich der Markt durch die Innenstadt — vom Rathausplatz über die Holstenstraße bis zum Holstenplatz. Die Stadt Kiel richtet ihn aus: keine gewerblichen Händler, keine Neuware außer Selbstgemachtem. Reservieren kann man nicht, aufgebaut wird ab 4 Uhr früh.
description.en: On several Sundays between April and October the market runs right through the city centre, from Rathausplatz along Holstenstraße to Holstenplatz. The city of Kiel runs it: no commercial traders and no new goods beyond handicraft. There is no booking, and sellers build up from 4 in the morning.
